svg.title: rev-dos-spectra
svg.desc: All201native saved energy samples for parent andq2 from−2to+2eV relative to each own EF. Panels use all600 orbital projections summed for total, Mo1-d summed over8Mo1 atoms, Mo2-d over8Mo2 atoms andS-p over24S in the common40atom cell. Native DOS units are retained without an extra spin multiplier or states/eV conversion. Every original finite value is plotted, including any negative values if present; no smoothing, broadening, interpolation or resampling is introduced. Lines only connect adjacent native data. Vertical lines and dots mark the Fermi sample. Selected orbital groups do not exhaust all600projections.

g.text: Energy from each phase’s Fermi level (eV)
